content: DO SQLite storage API: state.storage.sql.exec() with CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; results are cursors (streaming); recommended pagination is keyset WHERE id > ? ORDER BY id LIMIT n. DO free tier (since 2025-04): ~100k requests/day, 13k GB-s duration/day, storage included (5GB account-level reported by pricing pages - verify at deploy). DO storage is transactional and instantly consistent, unlike KV.
